% \break and \linebreak end the line, as in the PDF, where nothing comes
% before them on its line but text. A p{} cell's \centering or \raggedleft
% sets its lines centered or flush right.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{array,longtable}
\begin{document}
Before a break\break after the break.

Before a linebreak\linebreak after the linebreak.

Before a spaced linebreak \linebreak after it.

Before a demand\linebreak[4] after the demand.

Before a hint\linebreak[2] after the hint, which the PDF may not break at.

\begin{itemize}
    \item In an item\break after the break.
\end{itemize}

\begin{center}
    Centered before\break centered after
\end{center}

Boxed: \mbox{in an mbox\break} and on.

Before a backslash\\ after it, with one line end.

Before an hfil\hfil\break after it, on the same line on the page only, as tex4ht writes \verb|\hfil\break| after its own markup.

\begin{minipage}{6cm}
    A paragraph in a minipage.\par\break
    The next paragraph.
\end{minipage}

\begin{tabular}{|p{3cm}|p{3cm}|p{3cm}|}
    \hline
    \centering A centered cell, long enough to wrap &
    \raggedleft A flush right cell, long enough to wrap &
    A plain cell, long enough to wrap\break after a break \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{|>{\centering\arraybackslash}p{3cm}|>{\raggedleft\arraybackslash}p{3cm}|>{\centering}m{3cm}|l|}
    \hline
    Centered by the column, long enough to wrap &
    Flush right by the column, long enough to wrap &
    Centered in an m column & l \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{|>{\centering\arraybackslash}p{3cm}|p{3cm}|p{3cm}|}
    \hline
    \raggedright Flush left in a centered column, long enough to wrap &
    {\centering Grouped,} so justified, and long enough to wrap &
    \begin{tabular}{l}\centering inner\end{tabular} \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{center}
    \begin{tabular}{|p{4cm}|}
        \hline
        Justified in a centered table, long enough to wrap \\
        \hline
    \end{tabular}
\end{center}

\begin{longtable}{|>{\centering\arraybackslash}p{4cm}|}
    \hline
    Centered in a longtable, long enough to wrap \\
    \hline
\end{longtable}
\end{document}
